notes.title: MindLess Finally Released!
notes.content:
Hello everybody! After months of work, I'm proud to present to you all, MindLess! A strategy and action single-player game. Make your way through spinning, twisting halls. Prepare to encounter enemies at every corner!

Modes: 
 Simulation Mode (Story Mode)
 Survival Shooter Mode

Simulation Mode
 A linear obstacle memory course, that takes on the core mechanics of MindLess. Prepare to fight, run, and fly through halls and spaces of varying difficulty.
Survival Shooter Mode
 A third-person shooter mode with two maps: Station, and City blocks. Fight an endless horde of enemies, increasing in numbers every round. Teleport to different points as well to get different angles on the enemies. More maps and features will be added to this mode soon.
